gaps.lead: Nobody can deny that he works hard.
gaps.explanation: deny that + clause, or deny + -ing: deny his working (formal).

gaps.lead: I'm sure the tickets are expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: must be = I'm sure it is (deduction).

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the heavy rain.
The painter worked for three weeks on the mural.
gaps.explanation: spend + time + -ing: spent over three weeks (working on it).

gaps.lead: You can't park here — it's forbidden.
gaps.explanation: mustn't = it is forbidden (not: don't have to).

gaps.lead: He was in the habit of jogging every morning.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be in the habit of: was used to jogging.
